title: Clinical Lab Products: Survey Finds Digital Pathology and Genomics Shaping the Future of Cancer Care
summary: Clinical Lab Products highlighted findings from Labcorp’s Pulse of the Pathologist survey, which found that rising cancer rates are increasing demand for diagnostic services and accelerating interest in digital pathology, remote slide reading and genomic testing.
body_markdown:
*Clinical Lab Products* highlighted findings from Labcorp’s[Pulse of the Pathologist](https://www.labcorp.com/education-events/articles/pulse-pathologist) survey, which found that rising cancer rates are increasing demand for diagnostic services and accelerating interest in digital pathology, remote slide reading and genomic testing. Pathologists identified these technologies as important tools for improving efficiency and expanding capacity amid ongoing workforce challenges.


The article also notes that reimbursement concerns remain a barrier to adopting new technologies, particularly AI-enabled solutions, even as genomic profiling becomes a larger part of cancer diagnostics.


**Read the full** ******[Clinical Lab Products](https://clpmag.com/disease-states/cancer/labcorp-pathologist-survey-cancer-diagnostics-trends-2024/) **article to explore the survey findings and what they reveal about the future of pathology and cancer care.**
